hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Cairo? Hotel Prices for Cairo, Egypt | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_proxy.evidenceText: The exact Cairo hotel page reports $40 as the average price of 54 1-star hotels, with a $27 median. It describes a one-night stay, and states that all hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes and come from a Kayak base price. The page also states that star prices are before taxes and fees and change with seasons.
hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: BudgetYourTrip hotel-price analysis; page crawled today; prices vary seasonally and are before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_proxy.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Cairo Egypt 1-star hotel average price one night
hotel_1star_proxy.reason: This is only a source-defined double-occupancy proxy candidate. The first page supplies exact city/class, numeric one-night USD value, sample and tax exclusion; the companion destination page supplies the source-level occupancy convention. It is not an observed two-adult price and is not mapped or fitted.

double_occupancy_semantics.sourceTitle: Cairo Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Cairo: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
double_occupancy_semantics.evidenceText: The exact Cairo destination page says the average price paid in Cairo for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $22 (E£1,073), while one person sharing a room averages $11 per night; these costs are from reported traveler spending.
double_occupancy_semantics.occupancyEvidence: The average price paid in Cairo for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $22; one person sharing a room is $11 per night.
double_occupancy_semantics.referencePeriod: Destination travel-cost data page; travel cost data last updated June 12, 2026; page opened 2026-08-01.
